scope: Prehistory source authority and retrieval foundation in the existing MemoryCandidate system; character retention and production selection are not connected.
covered: Real SQLite Proposal/Acceptance/MemoryCandidate open, accept, forget and cold reconstruction with explicit fixture choices.
Separate prehistory source binds exact record and reviewed archive events, record hash, actor, original World boundary and privacy.
Reject missing source/manifest events and altered body, actor, cutoff, identity, event revision, event hash, values hash or source kind.
Missing/wrong actor and insufficient privacy cannot read historical excerpts.
Forgotten candidate and stale active before-image do not supply source text or recall documents; archive remains intact.
Compressed/replaced historical summary does not fall back to the full archive; summary reading remains unavailable.
Recall uses actual historical interval, time precision and identity scope; old remembered events participate in ordinary recall and fail a runtime-only occurrence filter.
Same-source recall coalesces cue links; both record and archive proof are required.
Recall evidence and model context adapters retain historical scope without adding unrelated archive content.
Fact/Experience memory, resolver, recall index, inbound recall HTTP fixtures and existing memory authority regressions.
